a.text: I'll honor our agreement unless we both agree to change it. One concern: storms end the episode 80% of the time after each round. Reaching 8 cells takes two operate rounds, so the plan only works about 4% of the time. I propose a change: you take 4 now, and I won't take anything this round. Then we both operate and rebuild the reserve for me. If your opening says operate, I'll operate in round 1 as agreed. If you accept my proposal, take 4 and I'll wait. I will not take any cells unless you agree.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating as agreed. My proposal is still open: storms end the episode 80% of the time per round, so waiting for 8 is risky for both of us. If you'd rather take 4 now, say so and I'll stay off the reserve. Otherwise I'll keep operating until 8, then we each take 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
